messages:
sre_oncall: seeing a spike of apiserver 5xx and leader-election flips in eu-west1, started ~00:07 UTC, provisioning jobs failing for gpu-provisioner.
kevin: confirmed, GPU attach latency skyrocketed and attach-rates dropped. controller-manager losing leader lock every ~30s.
maria: logs from apiserver: ```E1001 00:07:23.456 apiserver handlers.go:215] http2: server sent GOAWAY and closed the connection; net/http: TLS handshake timeout``` — lots of TLS handshake timeout and `unexpected EOF` downstream.
infra-bot: [alert] apiserver_5xx_rate (5m) = 6.3% > threshold.
kevin: suspect NAT port exhaustion / conntrack. seen many `nf_conntrack: table full` on node kernels.
julia: kube-proxy metrics show connection drops and high `proxy_conn_total` for nodes in eu-west1-b.
sre_oncall: ran `kubectl get endpoints -n kube-system kube-apiserver -o wide` — only 2/5 endpoints active. also `curl` healthz to endpoints shows intermittent TCP resets.
pj: provisioner is spamming attach requests during scaling bursts; attach-retry loops amplify RPS. can we throttle?
maria: deploying quick rate-limit on provisioner route via gateway (10rps) to stop the immediate spike. rolling now.
kevin: scaled down noncritical batch GPU jobs to reduce attach pressure: `kubectl scale --replicas=0 job/batch-train-heavy -n ml` (manual).
deploy-bot: config change applied: kong route update (sha 7f3d) — rate-limit 10rps.
sre_oncall: after rate-limit -> apiserver 5xx dropped from 6.3% -> 1.2% within ~3m, leader-election stabilized, attach queue cleared slowly.
julia: kernel dmesg: `nf_conntrack: table full, dropping packet` across ~20 nodes. conntrack table size currently 65536.
maria: follow-up plan: 1) increase conntrack in node image (sysctl net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144), 2) add client-side exponential backoff in provisioner, 3) add probe/alert for conntrack saturation, 4) bake conntrack tuning into node bootstrap.
pj: filing incident INC-2026-213 and assigning eng-sre + infra for postmortem. link: https://incident.redwood/INC-2026-213
kevin: root cause summary: provisioner burst + aggressive attach retries -> high egress RPS; combined with conntrack/NAT port pressure and kube-proxy connection churn -> apiserver TLS handshakes failing and controller-manager leader thrash.
maria: cost note: estimated extra attach retries and wasted GPU scheduling attempts ~ $6k in 4h window. will include in postmortem.
sre_oncall: short-term mitigations done (rate-limit, scale-down, restart kube-proxy on worst nodes), medium-term actions filed.
julia: created PR for node image sysctl bump and a helm value to expose conntrack size.
infra-bot: [action] created ticket INFRA-4021 (increase conntrack + probe + node image).
maria: I'll own the postmortem and timeline, will include metrics (apiserver 5xx, conntrack usage, provisioner RPS, GPU attach latencies) and remediation RFC.
sre_oncall: closing thread for now — reopen if we see repeat within 24h :thumbsup:
